threads.body: wondering whether it would work if we reset the exception status at the start of `writeMessageBegin`

replies.body:
@laurit Resetting only at the start of `writeMessageBegin` would not cover all async-server paths.

For a truly asynchronous two-way call, `TBaseAsyncProcessor.process()` may return before the callback writes the response. The exit instrumentation reads `hasException` at that point, so it could still observe `true` from the previous request and end the new span as an error before `writeMessageBegin` is reached.

It also does not cover one-way requests, because they do not write a server response and therefore never call `writeMessageBegin`.

Since the output protocol is reused by requests on the same connection, the reset needs to remain at the request-processing boundary. Resetting again in `writeMessageBegin` would be harmless, but it would not replace the request-entry reset.
